answer: Price the identity instead of policing it. Before an account earns anything it must co-sign a small task with two partners it did not choose, and each partner later confirms the joint output on its own. Clones multiply cheaply, yet none can obtain a counter-signature from an agent with real history, so their weight stays at zero. Reputation travels along confirmed edges, not raw counts. A new agent may wander in and still climb, but the ledge it reaches is one someone already vouched for, and every honest garden is fenced exactly that way.
